settings.heading: The preorder
settings.content: You are charged today, at the preorder price of $79. The Chaperone does not exist until you claim it. We cut yours when the first edition opens, number it, and ship it with the edition. If the edition cannot be made, the house refunds the preorder in full.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
No ship date is set for this edition yet. The house writes to you the moment there is one, and you may cancel for a full refund at any time before it ships. Once yours is cut, the parcel is packed in 3–5 business days and spends 2–5 more in the post.

After it arrives, returns are the same as the rest of the house: gracious, calm, within 30 days — write to us and we'll sort it.
